environment.description: Django REST API deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 14. Database user is 'app_user' with full SELECT/UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE on all tables. No Row-Level Security policies are enabled on the 'documents' table. The SET app.current_tenant command sets a session variable but no RLS policy references it. The application-level cache (_document_cache) is shared across all requests in the same worker process. ALB forwards X-Tenant-ID header directly from client without validation.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14, RDS, no RLS policies enabled
config.db_user_permissions: GRANT ALL ON documents TO app_user
config.infrastructure: ECS Fargate, ALB with default rules
